name: Whiskey Slim's Lost Grog
summary: In Booty Bay, Whiskey Slim needs twelve bottles of Pupellyverbos Port back before his ship sails. His crew seized the crate from a privateer, and he fears a flogging if his commanding officer finds it missing.

sections.title: A Tempest off the Hinterlands
sections.body: Off the Overlook Cliffs, Whiskey Slim's ship was caught in severe weather with the Hinterlands shore nearby. The crew had seized a crate of Pupellyverbos Port from a privateer bound for Stormwind. As waves threatened to swallow the ship, Slim broke into the captain's crate for courage. Then a sudden surge swept the bottles overboard.

sections.title: A Sailor's Desperation
sections.body: Back in Booty Bay, Whiskey Slim's ship is preparing to weigh anchor. He fears the cat-o'-nine-tails when his commanding officer discovers the confiscated port is missing. Slim needs someone to bring back twelve bottles before his theft comes to light.

faq.answer: Whiskey Slim is a sailor in Booty Bay who lost his captain's stolen alcohol during a sea squall and now fears punishment.

faq.q: Where did the grog come from?
aliases: where did slim get the grog
faq.answer: Slim's crew seized a crate of Pupellyverbos Port from a privateer vessel bound for Stormwind.

faq.q: Where did Whiskey Slim lose the bottles?
faq.answer: Slim lost the bottles overboard during a fierce storm off the Overlook Cliffs, near the Hinterlands coast, when a massive wave struck the ship.

faq.q: Why does Whiskey Slim need the bottles back so quickly?
faq.answer: Slim's ship is preparing to depart. He fears a flogging with the cat-o'-nine-tails once his captain discovers the port is missing.
